{{Quote|It's a ''freighter''. I asked for a fighter.|Kal Skirata|<ref name="TC" />}}
The '''''Aay'han''''' was a [[DeepWater-class light freighter|''DeepWater''-class light freighter]] often used for joyriding. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Kal Skirata]] purchased it second-hand from a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] in [[Calna Muun]] on [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] for the price of 80,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. He bought it because he wanted a craft with underwater capabilities to aid with his search for the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]], as he believed that she was hiding on a [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Planet/Legends|world]].<ref name="TC" />

==History==
[[Kal Skirata]]'s adopted son, [[Ordo Skirata]], suggested the name ''Aay'han'' for it, which was a word from [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]] that translates roughly as a state of mind of a peaceful and perfect moment where you are surrounded by friends and family, but at the same time missing dead loved ones to the point of pain.<ref name="TC" /> Skirata used this name in honor of a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] who died during training, [[Dov]], and Skirata's own adopted father [[Munin Skirata|Munin]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I||''Aay'han''}}</ref>

They soon got a chance to test it out, as just after they purchased it, they traveled to [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] in it, to extract [[Walon Vau]], who had fallen through Mygeeto's ice and got stuck in a crevice while trying to rob a [[Dressian Kiolsh Merchant Bank|bank]].<ref name="TC" />

After rescuing him, they flew the ''Aay'han'' to [[Bogg 5|Bogg V]] in the [[Bogden system/Legends|Bogden system]], to carry out modifications to it and fit it with military-grade sensors and weapons. They also rendezvoused there with [[Mereel Skirata|Mereel]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bardan Jusik]], who informed Skirata that Ko Sai had been sighted on [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]] and that [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] had been sent after her.<ref name="TC" />

Using Jusik's information, they tracked her to [[Dorumaa]] and Skirata, Vau, and Mereel flew there in the ''Aa'yhan''. Under the alias that they were there on a fishing trip, they used it to search underwater near the [[Tropix Island Resort]] and discovered a potential location where Ko Sai could be. They returned to Tropix Island to plan their assault on it and while there, purchased a [[Wavechaser]], which Skirata nicknamed ''[[Gi'ka]]'', to use as a runabout that could operate from the ''Aay'han''. Shortly after, Skirata and Mereel found and captured Ko Sai and brought her back to the ''Aay'han'' to transport her to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="TC" />

Prior to the activation of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], the ''Aay'han'' was moored in the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] [[Utilities Department standby underground reservoir]] in anticipation of planned "strategic disappearance" to Mandalore for all members of [[Clan Skirata]]. The ''Aay'han'' was moored down there; courtesy of people who owed [[Jaller Obrim]] favors, to keep it out of sight.<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

After the death of [[Etain Tur-Mukan]], the ''Aay'han'' was taken to [[Kyrimorut/Legends|Kyrimorut]] and was stored in a hangar concealed north of the house.<ref name="O66" />
